description: Tracker lifecycle hooks. Each runs only when `trk` is on PATH and never blocks Claude Code.

hooks.command: command -v trk >/dev/null 2>&1 && trk hook session-start --channel claude-code; exit 0
command -v trk >/dev/null 2>&1 && trk hook prompt --channel claude-code >/dev/null; exit 0
command -v trk >/dev/null 2>&1 && trk hook stop --channel claude-code >/dev/null; exit 0
